reviewer: Kimi independent actual visual comparison of the exact 65x67 source PNG, complete unchanged 2048x2048 raw RGBA, full white/cyan/alpha review sheet and unchanged naiwa.png mascot reference; checked the bald crown and remaining side hair, brows, facial hair, one mouth, eyewear, uniform, pose, crop, lighting, collar, complete card/note/backplate and visible transparency.

entries.positive_observation: The high bald crown remains bald while short gray-blond hair is still clearly present at the sides and back; light eyebrows are retained. The chin is smooth with no visible moustache or beard, there is one stern closed mouth, and no glasses were added. The three-quarter turn and gaze toward viewer left, uniformed upper-chest crop and soft directional cheek shadows remain. One dark olive uniform, light-gray shirt, one dark tie and paired pale metal-look collar tabs remain in their source positions. The collar fits closely beneath the rounded chin with a short broad neck transition and no long column, pinching, clipping or cream bib. The complete tilted dark frame, opaque muted gray-olive photographic backplate, overlapping warm-cream note with faint upper marks and mostly blank lower paper, and small dark right-edge tab remain. Actual full white/cyan viewing shows a genuine transparent exterior without visible interior holes, lost backing or a working-matte ring.
entries.alpha_decision: Accept native RGBA extrema 0..254 after actual white/cyan/alpha inspection; no source-alpha replacement was performed or needed, and 252-254 values alone were not treated as defects.
entries.visible_limitations: The exact collar-insignia shapes are unreadable at 65x67; only their visible pale shapes and placement were compared, without inventing rank symbols or medals. Note marks remain indistinct visual groups rather than readable text.
